components.name: Primary Transfer Button
components.description: Starts or confirms the current transfer-oriented action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 26px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #007af5; color: #fff; font: 700 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary span { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-left: 7px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #006ad9; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,106,217,.42); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar Icon Button
components.description: Compact standard action used by both explorer panes.
components.css: .ds-toolbar-button { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 8px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #1d1d1f; transition: color 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-toolbar-button svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-toolbar-button:hover { color: #007af5; background: rgba(0,0,0,.07); } .ds-toolbar-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,106,217,.42); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Explorer Search Field
components.description: Search and filter entry that remains stable while typing.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m15.5 14 5 5-1.5 1.5-5-5v-.8l-.3-.3A6.5 6.5 0 1 1 15.5 14Zm-5 0A4.5 4.5 0 1 0 10.5 5a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0 9Z"/></svg><input placeholder="Search files and folders"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: rgba(0,0,0,.6); transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, box-shadow 160ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #006ad9; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,106,217,.42); } .ds-search svg { width: 19px; margin-right: 8px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #1d1d1f; font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; }

components.name: Selected File Tile
components.description: A selected file with stable geometry and a visible selection state.
components.css: .ds-file-tile { display: grid; width: 118px; height: 155px; padding: 5px; place-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(0,106,217,.12); color: #1d1d1f; font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-file-preview { display: grid; width: 80px; height: 80px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid #006ad9; border-radius: 8px; color: #006ad9; font-weight: 750; } .ds-file-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,106,217,.42); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Filter Option
components.description: Theme-safe selected option used in file-type filters.
components.css: .ds-filter-option { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px 1fr auto; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; gap: 8px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(0,106,217,.12); color: #1d1d1f; font: 650 11.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-check { display: grid; width: 20px; height: 20px; place-items: center; border-radius: 4px; background: #007af5; color: #fff; } .ds-filter-option > span:last-child { color: rgba(0,0,0,.6); font-size: 10px; } .ds-filter-option:hover, .ds-filter-option:focus-within { background: rgba(0,106,217,.16); }

components.name: Device Status Badge
components.description: Identifies the connected device and its live connection state.
components.css: .ds-device-badge { display: flex; align-items: baseline; max-width: 235px; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-radius: 8px; background: #f5f6f8; color: #1d1d1f; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-device-badge span { color: rgba(0,0,0,.6); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-device-badge strong { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 12px; } .ds-device-badge i { width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-left: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: #2e9d62; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(46,157,98,.13); }

components.name: Transfer Route
components.description: Makes transfer direction explicit before progress begins.
components.css: .ds-transfer-route { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-radius: 10px; background: #f5f6f8; color: #1d1d1f; font: 700 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .ds-transfer-route strong:first-child { text-align: right; } .ds-transfer-route svg { width: 20px; fill: #007af5; }

narrative.overview: OpenMTP Refined is a focused two-device workspace. The Mac and Android panes are peers, each with the same navigation grammar, while connection and transfer state remain unmistakable. The interface is compact, precise, and optimized for long file-management sessions.
keyCharacteristics: Symmetric dual-pane structure with clear source and destination context.
Finder-familiar hierarchy, density, keyboard behavior, and file affordances.
Restrained blue accent used only for interaction and state.
Equivalent light, dark, keyboard, loading, error, and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The Transfer Direction Rule
rules.body: A transfer action must always identify its source, destination, item count, and current phase before destructive or time-consuming work begins.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is never decorative. It marks something actionable, selected, focused, transferring, or linked.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting toolbar, footer, list row, or file tile has no decorative shadow.

dos: Do keep source, destination, device identity, and transfer direction visible throughout an operation.
Do consume semantic theme roles for every state in both light and dark themes.
Do verify all interaction and operational states before shipping a component.
donts: Don't add decorative animation, pulsing buttons, bounce, or movement that slows the workflow.
Don't leave transfer states silent or make the user guess whether an operation started.
Don't create one-off controls or raw colors when a shared semantic component exists.
